resources.string: Looking for Nookdeck on this Wi-Fi…
No computer found. Is Nookdeck running, and is this phone on the same Wi-Fi?
Address shown on the computer, like 192.168.1.10:7420
Or plug the phone into the computer with USB debugging on, and click Set up on the computer\'s Devices tab.
Trying again by itself every few seconds: plugging the cable back in is enough.
